defect: A read started before a Type/visibility write could publish after acknowledged write receipt, restoring stale state or erasing the new conditional Undo. An old write defer could clear saving state after owner reactivation.
fix: Write start and accepted receipt invalidate read publication; read and write success/error/defer use original owner/request tokens. Refresh refuses during save. Deactivation keeps in-flight intent review-required. Internal operation bundle preserves exact native session/store paths and weak document ownership; every operation closure type is MainActor.
testBoundary: Tests inject suspended typed Host results into the actual AnyNativePropertyPresentation; real materialization and pure prepare/Undo contracts are reused. This is a presentation-ordering test seam, not native HTTP, authority, UI-mounted or end-to-end proof.
testDeadline: Each start rendezvous has a cancellation-aware 10-second failure deadline. Suite tests have one-minute limits; fixture cleanup removes and resumes all pending continuations.
